visual_grammar.label: Bipolar Dual-Canvas Map & Paper Collage Chronicle Engine (30fps)
visual_grammar.zero_static_hold_rule: 0% dead frames; every beat maintains continuous S-curve camera rig, subtle paper ambient drift, internal Polaroid Ken Burns, or 1.5-3.2s micro-beat HUD/VFX motion.

world_a_map_mode.canvas_role: Geographic causality, plume/pandemic dispersion, evacuation radii, structural epicenters, and cross-border impact

sovereignty_mandate.label_style: Bold uppercase white labels matching Vietnam territory color

camera_rig.continuous_inheritance: Inherit (cx, cy, zoom) across consecutive same-region map beats

vfx_and_overlays_30fps: nuclear_shockwave_blast (3-phase: 0-0.25s white flash -> 0.15-1.8s expanding shockwave ring -> #F2E288 Gaussian glow)

world_b_paper_mode.canvas_role: Root-cause engineering breakdowns, quantitative shock proof, archival evidence, and human/actor portraits
world_b_paper_mode.ambient_motion: Continuous subtle paper ambient drift (zero mirror seam, zero dead holds)
elements: 2D top-down technical schematics (e.g., Reactor #4 cross-section, control rods, steam loop, valve/dam geometry)
Tilted Washi-tape Polaroids (±2 to ±4 deg, 2 opposite-corner tapes, soft drop shadow, slow 1-2%/s internal Ken Burns)
White-outlined B&W character cutouts (4-6px hard #FFFFFF border + drop shadow + 0.35s easeOutBack slide-in)
Bespoke paper props (TELEGRAM, BÁO CÁO MẬT, SÉC, CHECKLIST [X][X][✓])
Animated bar charts, rolling number counters, and waffle pictogram grids (1/4, 1/6, 1/7, 1/30, 1/100)

collision_guard.bottom_right_watermark_clearance: Keep W-w-36:H-h-36 clear of Polaroids, stamps, and labels

flow_cdp_asset_policy.flow_beluga_scope: Clean B&W/sepia archival portrait plates & disaster scene Polaroid source plates (allowed_text=None, clean_beluga_sparkle_pil + 1.045x overscan) + 5-layer Flow-native thumbnails (<2MB).

voice_and_audio_lock.voice_style_source: KTTV Studio V3 (calm northern male documentary narrator)
voice_and_audio_lock.pronunciation_normalizer: chronicle_audio_mixer.py (compound-word protection + Vietnamese phonetic mapping e.g. Chernobyl -> Chéc-nô-bưn, Pripyat -> Pri-pi-át, RBMK -> Rờ-Bê-Mờ-Ca, AZ-5 -> A-Zét Năm, Sievert -> Xi-vơ)
voice_and_audio_lock.sfx_policy: Sparse Realistic Foley Only (geiger_counter_burst, steam_reactor_explosion, control_room_siren, sub_bass_chapter_boom, stamp_slam_thud, fire_crackle, telegraph_ticker) — zero dense UI pop/ding spam.

render_and_branching_lock.execution_target: Colab T4 GPU via ColabPoolDispatcher (h264_nvenc + OmniVoice); strictly zero local CPU video rendering; mandatory colab stop after completion.

thumbnail_5_layer_template.layer_3: Glowing orange flashpoint ring + 3 bold vector arrows
thumbnail_5_layer_template.layer_4: Top-left cream double-border box (#EFE8D5) with bold dark condensed title + bottom-left date stamp
thumbnail_5_layer_template.layer_5: Bottom-right B&W/sepia catalyst portrait cutout looking straight into camera
